caption: The drawing is composed of three main views of a spoon, rendered in pencil on a light beige background. At the top left, there is a small rectangular box with an overhead view of the spoon’s handle, showing some engraved details and possible markings, including text and a symbol. In the center section of the drawing, two larger, detailed overhead views of the spoon are placed one above the other, each displaying the full length of the object with shading indicating surface texture and curvature. At the bottom of the drawing, within a rectangular frame, there is a side profile view of the spoon, with a slight upward curve at the spoon’s bowl. The entire composition is contained within a larger, faintly drawn rectangular outline. The objects and lines appear as shades of grey, with no application of color other than the natural pencil shading and the off-white background. There is handwritten text in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Silver Teaspoon
